description: The CAGBOLT Assembled i5 Desktop PC is a dependable computing solution built for both office and home use. Powered by the Core i5-4570 4th Generation processor clocking up to 3.60GHz, it delivers smooth and efficient performance for everyday tasks. Equipped with 16GB DDR3 RAM and a fast 256GB SSD, this desktop ensures quick boot times, seamless multitasking, and ample storage for your files and applications. The integrated HD Graphics 4600 handles everyday visual tasks with ease. Connectivity is well covered with HDMI and VGA ports for display output, Ethernet for stable internet access, and USB 3.0 for fast data transfers. It comes pre-loaded with Windows 11 Pro and Office 2024, so you can get started right away without any additional software setup. Whether you are managing spreadsheets, browsing the web, or handling presentations, this desktop is built to keep up with your daily demands. Backed by a 2-year manufacturer warranty, the CAGBOLT Assembled Desktop PC offers dependable performance and peace of mind for long-term use.
